subject: Renewal QBR / Roadmap demo — workshop split & slate negotiation
messages:
From: Sarah Klein <sarah.k@acmehealth.com>
To: priyom_das <priyom@redwood.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal QBR / roadmap demo — proposal to split into two workshops

Thanks again for the overview last week. We talked internally and the execs want a focused session on (A) roadmap & commercial review and (B) platform walkthrough / technical deep-dive.

Quick ask: can we split the QBR into two back-to-back 60-minute workshops on the same day instead of one long session? The goals are: shorter exec timebox for pricing/contract decisions, then a hands-on technical hour for our engineering and security teams.

Preferred window: Tue 6/22 between 09:00–14:00 PT. If that doesn't work, Wed 6/23 morning is acceptable. Also looping in procurement (procurement@acmehealth.com) who will want the SOW redline ahead of the contract discussion.

Attachments: Proposed-calendar-grid.ics (calendar picks for both workshops)

Thanks,
Sarah Klein
Head of Platform Strategy
Acme Health

From: priyom_das <priyom@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Klein <sarah.k@acmehealth.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.com>, mina_haddad <mina@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal QBR / roadmap demo — proposal to split into two workshops

Sarah — thanks for the clear preference. Splitting into two 60-min blocks is fine; I want to call out two trade-offs so we're aligned:

- Logistics: back-to-back sessions increase the risk of overruns; we'll build a 10-minute buffer and a short async pre-read to keep the exec block tight.
- Attendees: we should limit exec attendees in the first block to decision-makers only so the pricing convo stays focused. Technical folks can join the second workshop.

Proposed schedule (we can confirm):
- Workshop A (Exec roadmap + commercial): Tue 2026-06-22 09:30–10:30 PT
- 10-min buffer / break: 10:30–10:40 PT
- Workshop B (Platform walkthrough + questions): Tue 2026-06-22 10:40–11:40 PT

Marissa / Mina — I'm attaching the runbook draft (QBR-runbook-v2.pdf) with the run-of-show and required pre-reads. Laura — can you own the calendar invites and the recording ops?

Let me know if the windows collide with any exec blackouts. If Tuesday is impossible, we can fallback to Wed 6/23 09:00–11:00 PT with the same structure.

Thanks,
Priyom
Account Executive, Renewal
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: QBR-runbook-v2.pdf (PDF)]

Adding a couple of operational checks and requests from our side:

- Pre-reads: I'll publish a 1-page executive summary and a 2-slide tech pre-read. Can you confirm the names/emails for all exec attendees so we can tailor the summary?
- Recording and breakout: Laura — let's set the recording to the main meeting and open a breakout channel for engineering Q&A in the second hour.
- Procurement: Devon, welcome — could you confirm whether Acme requires the SOW to be finalized before the roadmap conversation or if a redline is acceptable to discuss during the exec workshop? Procurement clarity will change which docs we need to circulate in advance.

I've redlined the SOW (attached) with our proposed minor edits. If procurement needs a final version, we'll expedite.

Thanks — I'll create the calendar draft and share the invites once we confirm attendees and the SOW status.

Best,
Marissa Cole

1) Please include a dedicated line in the SOW for data residency / log retention (we reference that in our security checklist).
2) Doc signing: we'll require a DocuSign packet for the final SOW and the amendments. Please send the DocuSign link once the redlines are accepted.

On scheduling — Tue 6/22 09:30 PT works for our execs. Confirmed attendee list below:
- Sarah Klein (Exec sponsor)
- Devon Price (Procurement)
- Dr. Elaine Park (CIO) <elaine.park@acmehealth.com>

Priyom / Marissa — please go ahead and send the invites and the DocuSign packet when ready. We'll join both sessions.

Regards,
